patch_description: The current best (0.80) runs a single polish after stochastic search. The key recommendation is that pair-exchange escapes compound when iterated. I restructure the pipeline into an outer compounding loop of 4 rounds, each running: `_pair_exchange` (40 structured two-point swap attempts moving the points of the current minimal triangle), then `_directed_polish` (coordinate-wise greedy with step 0.001, up to 15 shrink rounds), then `_hard_refine` (fine single/group stochastic refinement, step 0.0005, 20k accepts). The best configuration is always kept; two consecutive rounds with < 1e-12 improvement trigger early termination to control eval_time. Seed screening and stochastic phases are kept but slightly slimmed to pay for the outer loop.
